# This fixture is intentionally .vy.txt so normal compile-all globs do not pick
# it up as a passing test. It documents the expected diagnostic for V3B.
#
# Expected: compiling this as .vy fails because @device_fn helpers require an
# active @device region or another @device_fn caller.

@device_fn
fn helper(d :: Int64) {
    device_fill(d, 1.0, 1);
}

helper(0);
